cost_basis: est_cost_per_run_usd = mean estimated cost (USD, ASSUMED token prices) of one eval run of the ALDO returns-agent scenarios (A, B, C, D, E, H, P4) that called the model; ALDO bot purchase runs (P1, P2) are reported per scenario only.
latency_note: Latency = wall-clock time of the agent turns and API calls of one run (reset, DynamoDB reads and assertions excluded). Percentiles use nearest rank over the runs, so with N=3 p95 is the slowest run.
